dimensions.assessment: Affects employees of the Department of Veterans Affairs, including full-time health personnel appointed under chapter 74 of title 38.
dimensions.evidence: an employee of the Department of Veterans Affairs (including an employee who is appointed in the Veterans Health Administration)

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative eligibility for family and medical leave covering parents of a spouse for a specific federal agency workforce.
dimensions.evidence: a parent of the spouse of a covered employee shall... be deemed as a parent of the covered employee

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue figures are stated, though unpaid or substituted family leave may involve minor administrative or staffing adjustments.
Narrowly applies to family and medical leave eligibility rules specifically for Department of Veterans Affairs employees.
dimensions.evidence: for purposes of determining eligibility for the entitlement of the covered employee to leave under section 6382(a)(1)(C) of title 5

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory amendment governing leave eligibility for VA employees.

missing_information: The number of VA employees who would utilize this expanded leave definition is not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill ensures that for Department of Veterans Affairs employees, a parent of the employee's spouse is deemed a parent of the employee for determining eligibility for specific family and medical leave under title 5.

label: H.R. 7948

selection.reason: Impact scored by Gemini. (rated before the current eligibility rules; kept)

title: To deem certain individuals as parents of Department of Veterans Affairs employees for purposes of determining entitlement to certain family and medical leave for such employees.
